injuries.name: Mark Jankowski
injuries.note: Jankowski was a late scratch for Sunday's 3-2 loss in Calgary and is now unlikely to be available until after Carolina's current road trip concludes, which will be Saturday in St. Louis. As a result of Jankowski returning home, it wouldn't be surprising to see him land on injured reserve in the near future. While the Hurricanes have lost several forwards due to injury recently, the team is expected to have Seth Jarvis (shoulder) return to the lineup soon, as Brind'Amour said Friday that he's hopeful Jarvis will be able to play at some point during this road trip. Nicolas Deslauriers got back into the lineup Sunday due to Jankowski's absence.

injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
injuries.note: Nikishin hasn't signed a new contract as a restricted free agent and has officially requested a trade, though nothing has materialized as of yet. Even if the young defenseman were on the roster, he may not be playing on a nightly basis, with Mike Reilly potentially ahead of him on the depth chart.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Demko missed the second half of the 2025-26 season after undergoing hip surgery in January, and he was officially placed on injured reserve last week. He doesn't yet have a clear timetable for when he'll be back in action, but Sedin said that Demko is "taking steps every day" in his recovery process. While Demko is sidelined, Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen should compete for starts in the Canucks' crease.

injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Carolina Hurricanes placed F Taylor Hall on injured reserve on Monday (Oct. 19).

injuries.name: Mark Jankowski
injuries.note: Lower-Body: HC Rod Brind'Amour said Sunday (Oct. 18) that Jankowski has been sent back to Raleigh to have his lower-body injury assessed, according to Walt Ruff of the Hurricanes' official site.

injuries.name: Seth Jarvis
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Carolina Hurricanes said on Friday (Oct. 16) that Jarvis plans to travel with the Hurricanes during their upcoming five-game road trip, per Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News.

injuries.name: Jordan Staal
injuries.note: Calf: The Carolina Hurricanes placed F Jordan Staal on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 15).

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Hip: The Canucks placed Demko on injured reserve and hopeful he will be ready to return before Christmas, per Kevin Woodley of NHL.com.

injuries.name: Mackenzie MacEachern
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Mackenzie MacEachern on injured reserve non-roster.

injuries.name: Marco Rossi
injuries.note: Illness: Rossi did not play in Saturday's (Oct. 17) game against the Lightning.

injuries.name: Akil Thomas
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Akil Thomas on injured reserve non-roster.

injuries.name: Jack Thompson
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed D Jack Thompson on injured reserve non-roster list on Monday (Sep. 28).
